reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `dedupe-imports` (`62644c3`) against `main`:

*P1 — Deduplication uses object identity instead of contact ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` only removes repeated references to the same object. Separate imports produce different objects with the same ID, so overlapping contacts remain duplicated in `mergeImports`, contrary to the README’s first-seen-per-ID contract.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
```
Actual: both contacts. Expected: only the first (`Ada`).

Track seen IDs while iterating and retain the first contact for each ID. Add regression tests for separate objects sharing an ID, both directly through `dedupe` and across lists through `mergeImports`; the current duplicate test only repeats the same object reference.

All 4 existing tests pass, but both overlap checks above fail. No files changed.
